title: CLPS mission destinations
conventions: Latitude is positive north and longitude positive east, in degrees. Coordinates are published actual landing locations at source precision, not planned targets or independently verified survey positions. No mission ephemeris is bundled by this catalogue.

missions.name: Intuitive Machines IM-1
missions.summary: Odysseus landed on 22 February 2024. NASA reported seven days of surface instrument operations.
missions.payloads: Six NASA instruments explored navigation, descent sensing, radio emissions, plume effects and other technology questions.

coordinate.note: Published NASA NSSDCA coordinate rounded to 0.01 degree; not the earlier planned target.

missions.name: Intuitive Machines IM-2
missions.summary: Athena reached the surface on 6 March 2025. NASA recorded an early end to the mission the following day.
missions.payloads: PRIME-1 paired the TRIDENT drill with the MSOLO mass spectrometer to investigate subsurface material and volatiles. These were mission objectives, not a claim that every objective was achieved.

coordinate.note: Published NASA NSSDCA landing location; distinct from the planned touchdown target.

missions.name: Firefly Blue Ghost Mission 1
missions.summary: Blue Ghost landed on 2 March 2025 and its surface mission concluded on 16 March 2025.
missions.payloads: Ten NASA payloads addressed lunar heat flow, fields, dust, navigation and related science and technology. LuGRE tested Earth-based GNSS reception on the Moon.

coordinate.note: Published NASA NSSDCA coordinate; source lists longitude as 61.810 degrees east.

missions.name: Firefly Blue Ghost Mission 2
missions.lander: Blue Ghost with Elytra orbital spacecraft
missions.summary: NASA describes a two-spacecraft mission for far-side surface and orbital operations. The linked update does not establish an exact landing point or a completed flight.
missions.payloads: The August 2026 NASA update describes three NASA payloads for far-side research and technology. Payload manifests and schedules require a fresh check before operational use.
missions.coordinateNote: Region-only catalogue entry. Do not invent a marker position or use a far-side centroid as a verified observer coordinate.
